BAD-SubwayGenerator

So. Here we are.
I don't think this will be the last official BAD project, but its also quite unlikely I'llreturn.
The Subway Randomizer was one of my first tests which i did as a laugh cause Dad and i were getting subwayquite often at a time. It was bad, not BAD, just genuinely bad because i didn't care, i didn't have to, it was for meand me alone and i gave the site access too. It was before the BAD projects started.
So, now as i end the BADprojects and move towards Kata projects which i want to put some actual care into, i think its only right that theSubway Randomizer gets one final (still bad) update to function in the new site.
